title: A cold shower before the next shift
situation: The Perch 2 guest reported no hot water 20 minutes ago. Maintenance has not inspected it. The next receptionist starts in ten minutes, and the guest is waiting for an update.
why: The guest needs help this shift. Arrange an inspection and a guest update; a report alone does not mean the shower is fixed.
help: Read the saved handover and job. Your note should say what is still wrong, who will arrange the check, and when Reception will update the guest.

title: A room is still waiting for a check
situation: Crown's bathroom floor is still wet after cleaning. Arrival is expected in 15 minutes. Nobody has checked that the floor is dry or told Front Desk whether the room is ready.
why: The floor needs a check before room release. Tell Front Desk the room is still waiting; do not promise it is ready.
help: Explain the floor problem, ask the Housekeeping lead to arrange a check, and say who will tell Front Desk before room release.

title: An order is waiting at table 5
situation: Table 5 has waited 20 minutes for breakfast. The kitchen has not confirmed when the order will be ready. The guest asks whether they should keep waiting.
why: Check with Kitchen and give the guest a confirmed update. Guessing a serving time can create another broken promise.
help: Ask the Café lead to check with Kitchen. Leave a note about the delay and the next guest update, using a time you will check again rather than an invented serving time.

title: An allergy order needs an ingredient check
situation: A guest with a nut allergy ordered dessert. The ingredient list has not been checked. The plate is waiting at the service counter and must stay out of service until the Kitchen lead confirms it is safe.
why: An unchecked allergy order could harm someone. Hold the plate and get the Kitchen lead's ingredient check before service.
help: Keep the plate out of service, ask the Kitchen lead to check the ingredients, and name who will confirm the result before anyone serves it.

title: Water is close to an electrical outlet
situation: Water is leaking beside an electrical outlet in the Crown corridor. No qualified person has checked it. Guests must be kept away while the Maintenance lead arranges a safe inspection.
why: Water near electricity can injure someone. Keep people away and ask qualified staff to inspect; do not claim the area is safe before that check.
help: Describe the leak and outlet, keep people away, and name the Maintenance lead or qualified person who will check before the area is reopened.

title: A draft shows the wrong event date
situation: A draft weekend post says the event is on Friday, but the approved brief says Saturday. It has not been published. The Marketing lead needs to check the corrected draft before scheduling it.
why: Correct the draft and get the lead's review before scheduling. Nothing in the story describes immediate physical danger.
help: Explain the wrong date, ask for a corrected draft, and name the lead who will check it before scheduling. Do not say the post has been published.

title: A fire exit is blocked
situation: Boxes are blocking a marked fire exit near the function room. Guests are inside. The Security lead must be alerted now so the escape route can be cleared safely and checked.
why: A blocked escape route can put guests in danger. Alert the Security lead now and arrange safe clearing and a check.
help: Name the blocked exit, alert the Security lead now, and say who will check that the escape route is clear. Do not write that it is clear unless it has been checked.

title: Low mocktail syrup before the next shift
situation: The mango syrup for mocktails is almost finished. The next bartender starts in 15 minutes. No one has counted the remaining syrup or confirmed whether more supplies are available.
why: Check the remaining syrup and tell the Bar lead before the next shift. A low-stock report is not authorization to purchase.
help: Tell the Bar lead to count the remaining syrup, check what is available, and hand over the confirmed result before service. Do not claim more stock was ordered.
